title: Triton Vector Maximum Reduction
seoDescription: Compute a vector maximum with one Triton reduction program and masked tail lanes that cannot win comparisons.
description:
Compute the global maximum value across an arbitrary-sized vector in Triton using register tree reductions and masked tail lanes.

**Mathematical Formulation:**

$$
m = \max_{i=1}^N x_i
$$

**Step-by-Step Implementation:**
1. Load contiguous vector tiles into registers.
2. Mask invalid tail positions with negative infinity.
3. Perform parallel reduction tree using tl.max.
4. Atomically update global maximum accumulator.

**Returns:** Float representing maximum value.
